Let's get you up and running in just a few minutes! 🎉 1. 🔑 Setting Up Your AI Providers First, you'll need to get API keys for the AI services you want to use: OpenAI API Key Go to OpenAI's platform Sign up or log in Click "Create new secret key" Copy your API key Anthropic (Claude) API Key Visit Anthropic's console Sign up or log in Navigate to "API Keys" Create and copy your key Adding Your Keys to AGNT.gg Visit the Settings page Go to the "App Integrations" section Click the button for OpenAI, Anthropic, etc. Paste your keys in the popup field and click "Ok" to save 2. 🔌 Adding Integrations Connect your favorite apps to supercharge your workflows: Visit the Settings page Go to the "App Integrations" tab Click on the apps you want to connect (like Gmail, Slack, etc.) Follow the prompts to authorize each integration 3. 🎨 Creating Your First Workflow Let's create a simple workflow: Visit the Workflow Designer page Drag nodes from the left sidebar onto the canvas Connect nodes by dragging from one node's output to another node's input Click on each node to configure its settings Save and run your workflow 4. 🛠️ Using the Tool Forge Create custom AI tools to use in your workflows: Visit the Tool Forge page Give your tool a name Write instructions for what you want the AI to do Choose an AI model (e.g., GPT-4 or Claude) Click "Save" 5. ⚡ Adding Custom Tools to Your Workflow Go back to your workflow Add your custom tool from Tool Forge (if you created one) Click the "Start Workflow" button in the toolbar Watch your automation run! 🤔 Need Help? Join our Community Discord for support Happy automating! 🤖✨
